# HippoRAG 2 — sag-benchmark External Method

Uses an adapted HippoRAG 2 implementation for graph-based QA with igraph and
Parquet vector retrieval. See [`UPSTREAM.md`](UPSTREAM.md) for source provenance.

## Setup

Run all commands from this project directory (`external/hipporag2/` of the
repository root):

```bash
uv sync --frozen
```

Configuration is read from the repository root `.env` (loaded with
`--env-file ../../.env`). The following variables are honored; defaults are
shown and are safe to override:

| Variable | Default | Description |
|----------|---------|-------------|
| `LLM_MODEL` | `Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8` | LLM model name (paper default: `qwen3.6-flash`) |
| `LLM_BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:32768/v1` | LLM OpenAI-compatible endpoint |
| `LLM_ENABLE_THINKING` | unset (=0) | Set to `1` to keep the model's thinking chain; otherwise the caller passes the vendor-specific parameter to turn it off (`enable_thinking` for 302ai gateways, `chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking` for local vLLM) |
| `EMBEDDING_MODEL_NAME` | `text-embedding-bge-large-en-v1.5` | Embedding model name (paper default: `bge-large-en-v1.5`) |
| `EMBEDDING_BASE_URL` | `http://localhost:9990/v1` | Embedding OpenAI-compatible endpoint |
| `EMBEDDING_BATCH_SIZE` | `16` | Embedding batch size |
| `EMBEDDING_MAX_SEQ_LEN` | `512` | Max sequence length (falls back to `EMBED_MAX_TOKENS`) |
| `EMBEDDING_TOKENIZER_PATH` | unset | Optional local tokenizer dir for truncation (falls back to character estimation) |

The dataset source files are always read from the repository-root `dataset/`
directory, never from this project.

## Upload-Batch Isolation (source_config_id)

Each run binds to an SAG upload batch id (`source_config_id`, e.g.
`<dataset>-<timestamp>`, generated by `scripts/run_upload.py`).
Artifacts are archived under that id so a new upload never overwrites a
previous batch:

- `caches/<source_config_id>/` — dataset contexts/questions, graph index and vector
  stores (under its `<llm>_<emb>/` subdirectory), OpenIE results, LLM cache, index cost
- `outputs/<source_config_id>/<llm>_<emb>/qa_result/` — Step 3 retrieval and QA results
  plus their cost

Resolution order (built into each Step script):

1. `--source-id <id>` explicit flag;
2. latest upload found under `pipeline/evaluation/source/SAG/<model>/<dataset>/`
   (auto-discovery, same rule as `run_upload.py`);
3. fallback to the dataset name (prints a hint) so the pipeline stays
   reproducible without an SAG upload environment.

All three Step scripts accept `--source-id`.

## 3-Step Pipeline

```bash
# Step 0: Load dataset (writes caches/<dataset>/questions and contexts)
uv run --frozen --env-file ../../.env python reproduce/Step_0_load_dataset.py --data_name test_hotpotqa

# Step 1: Build index (igraph graph + Parquet vector stores under caches/<source_config_id>/)
uv run --frozen --env-file ../../.env python reproduce/Step_1_build_index.py --data_name test_hotpotqa
#   --force_reindex  强制重建索引；--force_openie  强制重新抽取 OpenIE（忽略缓存）
#   --openie_mode online|offline（external 集成仅支持 online）
#   --source-id <id> 显式绑定 upload 批次（默认自动发现最新批次）

# Step 3: Response (retrieve + QA)
uv run --frozen --env-file ../../.env python reproduce/Step_3_response.py --data_name test_hotpotqa

# Step 3 with an existing retrieval result: QA only, no re-indexing
uv run --frozen --env-file ../../.env python reproduce/Step_3_response.py --data_name test_hotpotqa --qa_only
```

Step 0 supports any dataset in the repository root `dataset/`, e.g. `narrativeqa`
(whose QA file has no gold docs; recall is therefore always 0 for it).

Index artifacts go to `caches/<source_config_id>/`, final Step 3 results to
`outputs/<source_config_id>/<llm>_<embedding>/qa_result/`. Without an SAG
upload record the directory level falls back to the dataset name.

## Output Locations

| Artifact | Path |
|----------|------|
| Index | `caches/<source_config_id>/<llm>_<emb>/graph.graphml` |
| Vector stores | `caches/<source_config_id>/<llm>_<emb>/*_embeddings/vdb_*.parquet` |
| OpenIE results | `caches/<source_config_id>/openie_results_ner_<llm>.json` |
| LLM cache | `caches/<source_config_id>/llm_cache/` |
| Index cost | `caches/<source_config_id>/<llm>_<emb>/cost.json` |
| QA results | `outputs/<source_config_id>/<llm>_<emb>/qa_result/qa_results_latest.json` |
| Retrieval results | `outputs/<source_config_id>/<llm>_<emb>/qa_result/retrieval_results_latest.json` |
| Retrieval metrics (`--retrieve_only`) | `outputs/<source_config_id>/<llm>_<emb>/qa_result/retrieval_metrics_latest.json` |
| Retrieval + QA cost | `outputs/<source_config_id>/<llm>_<emb>/qa_result/cost.json` |

`<source_config_id>` falls back to `<dataset>` when no SAG upload record exists.

The Judge adapter accepts the canonical `outputs/` layout above.

## Convert & Judge

After Step 3, run both commands from the repository root:

```bash
# 1. Convert the newest model output.
uv run --frozen --env-file .env python scripts/run_llm_judge.py convert \
  --project hipporag2 \
  --datasets <dataset>

# 2. Run generation and retrieval Judge metrics.
uv run --frozen --env-file .env python scripts/run_llm_judge.py evaluate \
  --project hipporag2 \
  --dataset <dataset>
```

CLI parameter: `--top-k K` limits Judge evaluation to the first K rows of the canonical predictions file, preserving file order; omit it to evaluate all rows.

Judge results are written to
`evaluation/hipporag2/<dataset>/<source_run_id>/llmjudge/<judge-model>/<judge-run-id>/`.
